name: Cost
description: What each feature costs to run each month: infrastructure, SMS and model spend, read against the project's SMS bill.

fields.label: Monthly cost
fields.description: Everything the feature costs to run in production last month, SMS and model spend included.

fields.label: SMS spend
fields.description: The part of the monthly cost that is SMS sends. Omitted for features that send no SMS.

fields.label: Model spend
fields.description: The part of the monthly cost that is model API calls. Omitted for features that call no model.

fields.label: Project SMS bill
fields.description: The whole project's SMS bill this month, read from the sms-spend KPI. The same for every feature.

rules.reason: Sends SMS while the project's SMS bill is {projectSmsUsd} USD a month
